changelog: Anime that finds the right episode: Long-running series, multi-cour seasons and new releases now match the correct episode and server.
A new server picker for BigPicture: A cleaner layout made for the big screen, with a button to refresh servers anytime.
Watch Party on Discord: Friends can see when you're in a party and how many people are watching.
Faster everywhere: Desktop menus preload on hover.

features.title: Expanded Anime Support
items: Smarter matching: Series like One Piece, Boruto , where TMDB and AniList count seasons differently, now open on the right episode. Rare mismatches can still happen.
Absolute episode numbering: Long-running anime are sorted by season while still pointing to the correct episode.
Clear alerts: If an anime needs your attention, you now get a warning instead of a blank player.
BigPicture support: Anime data and matching  work in BigPicture mode too.

features.title: Discord Watch Party
items: Live status: Your Discord activity shows when you're in a watch party.
Party size: Friends see how many people are watching with you.

features.title: Interface & Usability
items: Redesigned server selector: A new layout for BigPicture that makes picking a server quicker.
Manual server refresh: A sync button in the server menu lets you check for new or updated servers whenever you want.
Faster navigation: Desktop menus start loading content as soon as you hover over them.
